patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Customer.io and Kit share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Customer.io and Kit share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Customer.io only if your buying job matches “Product-led event-driven messaging across email, push, SMS, and in-app — MAP-adjacent to c” rather than Kit's shape. Choose Kit only if your buying job matches “Creator and newsletter ESP (formerly ConvertKit) with landing pages, automations, and digi” rather than Customer.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Customer.io leans ecommerce-email; Kit leans small-business-campaigns. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Customer.io and Kit share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Customer.io is Product-led event-driven messaging across email, push, SMS, and in-app — MAP-adjacent to classic ESPs.; Kit is Creator and newsletter ESP (formerly ConvertKit) with landing pages, automations, and digital product selling..
- Company-size focus: Customer.io (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Kit (micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Customer.io-leaning ecommerce-email vs Kit-leaning small-business-campaigns.
- Researched limits: Customer.io — Essentials from $100/mo — not an SMB freemium ESP; Kit — Free Newsletter plan limits automations vs Creator/Pro.

Limitations — Customer.io: Essentials from $100/mo — not an SMB freemium ESP; Event/profile model requires product data maturity; Kit: Free Newsletter plan limits automations vs Creator/Pro; Paid pricing scales with subscribers.

Poor-fit cases: Customer.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Essentials from $100/mo — not an SMB freemium ESP · Kit is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free Newsletter plan limits automations vs Creator/Pro · Avoid Customer.io if you actually need Kit's motion (Creator and newsletter ESP (formerly ConvertKit) with landing pages, automations)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
